# `<sl-sidebar-item>` — Sidebar Item

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Sidebar items are the links inside a [sidebar group](sidebar-group.md).

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/sidebar-item/sidebar-item.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-badge>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | The URL to direct the user to. |
| `target` | — | `_blank`, `_parent`, `_self`, `_top` | — | Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is set. |
| `current` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Marks this as the item for the current page. |
| `count` | — | `string \| undefined` | — | An optional count shown at the end of the item. |
| `collapsed` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Set by the parent `<sl-sidebar>`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The item's label. |
| `prefix` | An optional icon. Items with an icon stay visible (icon only) when the sidebar is collapsed; items without one are hidden. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper, an `<a>`. |
| `prefix` | The prefix container. |
| `label` | The item's label. |
| `count` | The item's count, an `<sl-badge>`. |

## Documentation and examples

Used inside [`sl-sidebar`](sidebar.md). See the sidebar page for full examples.

```html
<sl-sidebar no-toggle style="--width: 20rem; height: auto;">
  <sl-sidebar-group label="Procurement (SAP)" count="71">
    <sl-icon slot="icon" name="cart"></sl-icon>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="13" current>Purchase Request</sl-sidebar-item>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="18">Purchase Order</sl-sidebar-item>
  </sl-sidebar-group>
</sl-sidebar>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/icon/icon.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/sidebar/sidebar.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/sidebar-group/sidebar-group.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/sidebar-item/sidebar-item.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-sidebar-item-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-sidebar no-toggle style="--width: 20rem; height: auto;">
      <sl-sidebar-group label="Procurement (SAP)" count="71">
        <sl-icon slot="icon" name="cart"></sl-icon>
        <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="13" current>Purchase Request</sl-sidebar-item>
        <sl-sidebar-item href="#" count="18">Purchase Order</sl-sidebar-item>
      </sl-sidebar-group>
    </sl-sidebar>
  `
})
export class SidebarItemExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Collapsed

In a collapsed [`sl-sidebar`](sidebar.md), items with a `prefix` icon are shown icon-only and centred, while
items without an icon are hidden. Give top-level items a prefix icon when the sidebar can be collapsed.

```html
<div style="height: 220px; display: flex;">
  <sl-sidebar collapsed>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#" current><sl-icon slot="prefix" name="briefcase"></sl-icon>Projects</sl-sidebar-item>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#"><sl-icon slot="prefix" name="folder"></sl-icon>Documents</sl-sidebar-item>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#"><sl-icon slot="prefix" name="gear"></sl-icon>Settings</sl-sidebar-item>
    <sl-sidebar-item href="#">Hidden when collapsed</sl-sidebar-item>
  </sl-sidebar>
</div>
```

> **Tip:** In Figma the Sidebar Item master has a `Collapsed` variant: icon-only, 44×36, available with `Prefix=true` only.
